title: Ilizwi Lobulumko
intro: Ilizwi elithambileyo lobulumko elalikade linikwa isiluleko esidlula ixesha. Lo mntu, osikelelwe ngokuqonda okunzulu, wadlulisela izifundo ezibalulekileyo ezihlala zisibane kubo bonke abalangazelela ulwalathiso. Ngaba ungasityhila isizathu sokuba la mazwi ahlala ehleli?
clues: Ndinikwe intsikelelo enkulu evela ku-Allah, isipho esakhanyisela intliziyo nengqondo yam.
Ndajika ndajonga umntwana wam endimthandayo, ndinqwenela ukwabelana naye ngobutyebi obuxabisekileyo endandinabo.
Ndalumkisa ukuba olona lwaphulo-mthetho lukhulu kukwakha amadlelane noThixo omnye wenyaniso.
Ndikhumbuze ukuba nobunzima bembewu yemostade, efihliweyo ngaphakathi kwelitye okanye ngaphaya kwesibhakabhaka, iya kuphendulwa nguAllah.
Ndibayalele ukuba bathobele abazali, nangona ukuthobela kuxhomekeke kuphela kwimiba yobulungisa.
Ndifundise iindlela ezilula: hamba ngokuthobeka emhlabeni kwaye uthomalalise ilizwi lakho; kuba isandi esiqatha kukugquma kweedonki.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
